tech_stack: C# / ASP.NET Core 6+, Redis (breadcrumb + content-detail cache), no owned DB — all persistence delegated to upstream services via HTTP and SDK providers

http_deps: ContentProfileService — profile versions, folder/file tree, permissions, favorites, followers, breadcrumbs
ContentManagerService — file metadata, versions, discussions, reviews, experts, custom properties, team-site resolution
ContentDiscoveryService — search-based content location, page preload data
UserManagementService — user info, group membership, current user type, username, default profile id
BlobStorageService — thumbnail URL signing, multi-download URL generation
PageStorageService — freestyle slide page data for PPTX/GSLIDES
DeclarativeAdminSettingsService — tenant DocCenter settings (ratings, reviews toggle)
DiscIntakeService — content view events for analytics (HTTP POST)
ContentAugmentationService — barcode augmentation blobIds, watermarked download URLs
Monolith — file current version resolution (legacy bridge)
SearchService — content location lookup, user permission validation via search index
LaunchDarkly (SDK) — feature toggles (barcoding, navigation, multi-language variant)

domains.name: File
domains.responsibility: Resolves, enriches, and exposes a content file's metadata, thumbnails, instructions, experts, HTML site info, and language variants for a given profile context.
domains.health_reason: FileService is a transaction script — all business rules (permission gating, field merging, rating masking) live in the application service and FileHelper utility; no domain entity with behaviour exists, and ContentDetailService duplicates the same orchestration pattern at 400+ lines.

invariants: A file can only be viewed if the requesting user has permission on the associated profileVersion
A file must have both ContentId and VersionId to be considered resolved
HTML site access is only valid for content of type HTML_ARCHIVE with format ZIP
Rating fields must be zeroed when tenant setting EnableRating is false

domains.name: Folder Navigation
domains.responsibility: Browses the folder hierarchy within a content profile, returning children listings, subfolders, breadcrumb trails, ascendant paths, and item-type detection.
domains.health_reason: FolderService delegates almost entirely to ContentProfileServiceProvider; the only logic present is Redis breadcrumb caching. ItemService has just two methods. No domain entity enforces folder invariants.

invariants: A folder must belong to exactly one profile version
Path segments prefixed with 'lf' are file items, not folder items

domains.name: Content Profile
domains.responsibility: Manages published and predicted content profile versions (library views), including landing pages, logos, thumbnails, default-profile resolution, and channel profiles for NewsCenter.
domains.health_reason: ProfileService orchestrates multiple provider calls with refill logic (thumbnail URL generation, IsDefault flagging) in-lined; blocking GetAwaiter().GetResult() calls inside Parallel.ForEach risk thread-pool starvation under load.

invariants: Exactly one profile version per user session must be marked as IsDefault
An unpublished profile version name is displayed as ProfileName + ' - ' + VersionName
Predicted profiles are excluded from normal listing unless includePredicted=true

domains.name: Content Engagement
domains.responsibility: Enables users to post questions, answers, and star-rated reviews on content, with permission enforcement and tenant-level masking of review/rating fields.
domains.health_reason: Permission gating occurs in the application service and settings-driven field masking (zeroing ratings, blanking review text) is applied correctly; however no domain events are raised for new engagement, and Discussion and Review share no common engagement abstraction.

invariants: A user must have permission on the associated profileVersion before accessing or posting engagement
When EnableRating is false, rating fields must be zeroed before returning to the client
When EnableReview is false, review title and content must be blanked before returning to the client

domains.name: Subscription
domains.responsibility: Manages user follow/unfollow relationships for content profiles and individual file or folder items, served on both the DocCenter library and NewsCenter surfaces.
domains.health_reason: FollowerService is a pure pass-through to ContentProfileServiceProvider; the only 'logic' is setting response.Ok=true and response.IsFolder=true, which are presentational concerns that belong in the mapper.

invariants: A subscription target is exactly one of: profile version, folder item, or file item

domains.name: Content Augmentation
domains.responsibility: Produces watermarked download URLs and barcode-embedded multi-file download manifests, applying format eligibility rules, per-item permission checks, and graceful fallback to source blobs.
domains.health_reason: ContentAugmentationService contains real business logic (PPTX/PDF format gating, feature-flag-controlled barcoding path, fallback to source blob on augmentation failure); these rules are correct but in-lined in the application service rather than expressed as domain invariants.

invariants: Barcode augmentation is only supported for PPTX and PDF formats
Every item in a multi-download manifest must pass individual permission check
If barcode augmentation fails, fall back to source blobId rather than failing the whole manifest

domains.name: Universal Player
domains.responsibility: Generates streaming playback manifests for content, attaches viewer watermark data, proxies to the upstream player service, and produces a structured failed-manifest response on error.
domains.health_reason: Permission check and watermark application are present; however the service is a thin proxy with no domain model — request mutation (attaching watermarkData, resolving teamsiteId) is done imperatively in the application service.

invariants: A playback manifest can only be generated if the user has permission on the associated profileVersion
Watermark data (application=DocCenter, viewerId) must be attached before forwarding to the player service

domains.name: Content Location
domains.responsibility: Resolves the profile-scoped navigation path (profileVersionId, itemId, teamSiteId, redirectUrl) for a given contentId or shared-link, using a search-first with CPS fallback strategy.
domains.health_reason: LocationService contains meaningful fallback and default-profile resolution logic, but it is expressed as 200+ line conditional orchestration in a single method; analytics event dispatch (DiscIntake) is fired as an in-line side effect rather than via a domain event.

invariants: A content location must belong to a profile version accessible to the current user
If search does not index the content, a CPS fallback must be attempted before raising NotFound
A URL-type content must trigger a Disc analytics event after successful resolution

domains.name: User
domains.responsibility: Provides user profile cards, group membership, user type classification, per-object permission validation across profiles/content/folders, and favorite file management for the current user.
domains.health_reason: UserService contains cross-cutting permission-check logic using ConcurrentBag + parallel tasks; user identity concerns are mixed with content-permission checks against CPS and Search. UserFavoriteFileService is a thin pass-through with no invariants.

invariants: A user's access status to a target object is exactly one of: Ok, NoPermission, or Unknown
Permission for profile access is validated via CPS; permission for content/folder access is validated via Search index

domains.name: Custom Property
domains.responsibility: Retrieves content-level and team-site-level custom metadata properties, filtering to DocCenter-visible properties only.
domains.health_reason: CustomPropertyService contains only one business rule (IsVisibleInDocCenter filter) expressed as a LINQ clause rather than a domain concept; all other logic is provider delegation.

invariants: Only custom properties with IsVisibleInDocCenter=true are exposed to the client

domains.name: Feature Flag
domains.responsibility: Evaluates tenant- and user-scoped feature toggles from LaunchDarkly and the FMS feature management service, exposing barcoding, meeting ingestion, and navigation capabilities.
domains.health_reason: FeatureService is a pure delegation facade over LaunchDarklyServiceProvider and FeatureFlagAccessor; all evaluation logic lives in the infrastructure providers.

invariants: Feature evaluation falls back to LaunchDarkly when no FMS rule is present for the given key

domains.name: Pre-Load Data
domains.responsibility: Assembles a bundled payload of profile, folder, file, and settings data for the DocCenter initial page load, using in-process single-flight coalescing to prevent cache stampede on concurrent first requests.
domains.health_reason: PreLoadDataService is a read-side view assembler with caching infrastructure; the single-flight pattern (ConcurrentDictionary<Lazy<Task>>) is a valuable invariant but is infrastructure plumbing rather than domain logic.

invariants: Concurrent requests for the same pre-load cache key must coalesce into a single upstream call
A Redis sentinel value distinguishes 'confirmed no redirect' from a transient failure (which must not be cached)

steps.label: Decode double-encoded fullPathId from client
Redis cache lookup for ContentDetail by profileVersionId+fullPathId+tenant+userId
GET file current version from Monolith (legacy bridge)
GET full ContentDetail from ContentProfileService
Parallel: GET file extra from ContentManagerService
Parallel: GET file variants from ContentManagerService (LD-gated)
Parallel: GET DocCenter settings from DeclarativeAdminSettingsService
Parallel: Evaluate ShowDoccenterNavigation toggle (LaunchDarkly/Matrix)
Parallel: GET username from UserManagementService
Merge file extra — apply rating masking, navigation flag
GET freestyle slide info from ContentManagerService (PPTX/GSLIDES only)
GET page storage data from PageStorageService (supported formats only)
GET content permissions from ContentManagerService
Assemble and cache ContentDetailResponse in Redis
GET user default profile from UserManagementService
Search index lookup via SearchService
Backfill default profile info onto search result
Fallback: GET published profile versions from ContentProfileService
Fallback: GET user-accessible profiles from ContentProfileService
Fallback: GET content location from ContentProfileService
URL-encode redirect URL
POST content view event to DiscIntake (analytics side-effect)
Evaluate barcoding and meeting-ingestion feature flags
GET teamSiteId from ContentProfileService
For each item: check user permission via ContentProfileService
For eligible PPTX/PDF items: GET barcode blobId from ContentAugmentationService
On augmentation error: fall back to source blobId
GET signed multi-download URL from BlobStorageService
Check user permission via ContentProfileService
Resolve teamsiteId from ContentManagerService if missing in request
Attach watermark data (application=DocCenter, viewerId)
Proxy streaming request to UniversalPlayerService
GET children listing from ContentProfileService via ChildrenAllReFillerManager
For each child file: GET file extra from ContentManagerService
For each child file: generate thumbnail URL from BlobStorageService
Assemble enriched ChildrenResponse
Add/Delete/Get follower record via ContentProfileService
Set response.Ok = true (presentational logic in domain service)
Set response.IsFolder = true for folder targets (presentational logic in domain service)

gap_analysis.title: No domain entities — all services operate on DTO response objects
ContentDetailService: 400-line god-method orchestrating 7+ providers
FolderService directly instantiates ChildrenAllReFillerManager (new keyword)
Blocking async calls inside Parallel.ForEach in ProfileService
All domain identifiers are untyped strings — no value objects
No domain events raised for state-changing operations
gap_analysis.detail:
User follows a profile, adds a review, favorites a file, resolves a content location — none of these raise a domain event. Side effects (e.g., the Disc analytics HTTP POST in LocationService) are fired imperiously via direct provider calls inside the application service, creating tight coupling between the location-resolution flow and analytics infrastructure.

Missing events: ProfileFollowed, ProfileUnfollowed, ItemFollowed, ItemUnfollowed, ReviewSubmitted, FavoriteAdded, FavoriteRemoved, ContentLocationResolved.

gap_analysis.title: Presentational logic (Ok, IsFolder flags) in domain layer
Typos in public interface names baked into DI registration
gap_analysis.detail: IProflieService (should be IProfileService) and IFolderServcie (should be IFolderService) are typos registered in DI and referenced in every consuming controller. They indicate the interfaces were never corrected after initial creation and reduce discoverability.

gap_analysis.title: Large commented-out code blocks in production service files
gap_analysis.detail: ContentDetailService, UniversalPlayerService, LocationService, and ProfileService all contain multi-line blocks of commented-out code representing old implementations or disabled logic. These obscure the active code path and increase cognitive load; git history preserves the original intent.

gap_analysis.title: ChildrenAllReFillerManager is an unclassified orchestration utility in the domain layer
gap_analysis.detail: Core/ReFillers/ChildrenAllReFillerManager directly coordinates calls to ContentProfileServiceProvider, ContentManagerServiceProvider, and BlobStorageServiceProvider. It is not an application service, domain service, or provider — it is infrastructure orchestration living in the domain layer, bypassing the boundary that IContentProfileServiceProvider is meant to enforce.
